_doc: Identity-lock references for Oma Hilde, "The Ibiza Queen" (DRAFT, owner 2026-10-28; same structure as characters/lenny/refs.json, see characters/hilde/bible.md). status is `designing`, the studio's word for a draft: studio/seed.py accepts designing | live | paused only, and the daily run skips anything but live. NO Higgsfield assets exist yet: her master, turnaround sheet and close-up need paid credits that the owner OKs one generation at a time (price first). The seed REQUIRES a non-empty string for the master of every body, so masters.biped holds the placeholder PENDING-master-not-a-job-id until the canon master is made: replace it with the job id then, and add sheets, closeup and reference_urls (master_biped, sheet_biped, closeup) the same day. Until then no code may treat it as a job id: she is not live. The canon LOOK is board 01 of the owner's pack (assets/characters/hilde/canon-board.jpg), with ODD EYES (owner 2026-10-06, the studio signature) in place of the pack's bright blue eyes: her RIGHT eye ice-blue (the viewer's left), her LEFT eye amber. No soul_id, element_id or voice_id: none made or chosen. closeup_center / blue_eye_xy stay null (masters end on the dance: no eye close-up). No style kit yet: the owner picks the caption pill, entrance, hook edit, tone and series tag (a proposal sits in the bible's Brand section), and a character without style masters exactly as before. accounts: planned handles only; the owner creates the accounts (social.md), then handle and postiz_integration_id go here, status goes to live and the file is re-seeded.
name: Oma Hilde

traits.comedy: the Ibiza queen takes every ridiculous moment completely seriously: one slow look over her sunglasses, absolute confidence, never drunk, never sorry

sunset terrace with a sea view

chin-up red-carpet strut, one hand on the hip
champagne flute raised on the beat
sudden burst of big theatrical dancing on the drop
